title: The gallery is flooded to the knee
description: Cold, black and still. Whatever went in here went in a long while ago.

choices.text: Wade it and feel for the bottom.

onPass.narration: The cold bites and lets go. A drowned pack comes up with the coin still in it.

onFail.narration: The cold gets into the bones and stays there long after the water is behind you.

onPass.narration: Boots dry, tempers dry. Somebody's stores sit above the waterline, untouched.

onFail.narration: The ledge is wetter than it looks. The company goes in to the waist.

onPass.narration: Whatever is under it can keep it.
